_meta.title: S43 — charter-unit template: live adjudication of the 47 whole-unit held rows
_meta.population: the whole-unit subset of the 95 rows held by #252 for the charter-unit template
_meta.derivation: s42 §6 amended PUBLISH (154) minus the 59 pks #252 wrote, filtered to unit==whole-unit. The s42 parse reproduces those 59 pks exactly against the tree, which is what corroborates the untracked s42 evidence file.
_meta.dateValidityRule: s42: a reading counts only when availability.start_at[0:10] === the requested date. Everything else is discarded, not repaired.
_meta.zeroRules: D-575: a $0 tier is not a fare and never wins the base. D-505: a reading whose every tier is $0 is contamination. Per the #252 convention $0 tiers ARE retained inside priceBreakdown, so they appear in liveTiers here.
_meta.productIdentity: (customer_type.id, singular, note, min_party_size) — never the tier id alone, never the label alone.
_meta.basePriceRule: publish price is the WINNING TIER's own floor across valid readings, never the ladder minimum across all tiers. Cheapest tier is not base fare.
_meta.ruling: Option 1 (2026-08-24): publish 569816 and 663614 only, idiom "From $X · private boat". The other 40 cleared rows stay HOLD — the ruled idiom asserts a product kind, and only these two are watercraft. s44 adjudicates per-kind labels AND catalogue scope (the vehicle/shuttle subset may be the ground-transfer class WUSVI ruled out of scope).
openFindings: PARTY_BARE prefix evasion: s42 amendment 1 anchors ^(N|one..ten)\s+(person|people|ppl|pax)$. Live labels carry prefixes — "Private Group Tour | 2 People" (pk 40692) and "Private Group | 3 People or More" (pk 5651) — so step 5 never fires and a per-person rate inside a party tier survives as the base. 40692 would publish $350 while a solo buyer pays $700. Same class as the kid|kids and bare-N-People gaps. NEEDS RATIFICATION.

s42 internal inconsistency: §6 per-row units give other=42, per-item/duration=6 for the held 95; the s42 write-population summary gives 38 and 10. Both sum to 95 and whole-unit=47 agrees exactly, so this does not affect the s43 population.
Stored-breakdown minima below published base: re-derived 21 of 59 on the #252 rows; s42 states 20. Delta +1, immaterial here, recorded because every claimed figure is untrusted.

gateBlastRadius.note: The gate branch matches NORMALIZED priceLabel (trim + toLowerCase), so it also picks up rows already carrying "Private Boat" in title case. These were NOT part of the 47-row s43 population and were not written by this pass; they were already published (priceConfidence high, priceBreakdown present) and were simply invisible on curated pages because the old gate did not recognise the label. Both were live-verified here before being allowed to render.

gateBlastRadius.curatedSurfaceEffect: Exactly 2 rows render "From $X · private boat" on the 13 curated pages: 663614 (written here, fishing.html) and 277531 (pre-existing, snorkeling.html + snorkeling-tours-hawaii.html). The other written row 569816 and the other pre-existing row 153715 match NO curated page predicate — 569816 is tagged only "Boat Tour" on big island and 153715 only "Boat Tour" on kauai, and no curated page filters on that tag. So the branch carries 2 rows on curated surfaces, but not the two that were expected.

_meta.schemaNote: priceCentsSeen and floorCents are integer cents as returned by FareHarbor. liveTiers is sorted by floorCents then id. Rows sorted by pk. No clock reads: this file regenerates byte-identically from the same sweep.
